body.x: Mediaiplus participated in the CES 2025 Pangyo Lunch Talk on February 20 at the Gyeonggi Startup Campus in Pangyo Techno Valley. This event showcased the innovative technologies of Pangyo-based companies attending CES 2025, facilitated discussion of industry trends, and expanded global business opportunities.

At this event, Mediaiplus shared insights on its first participation in CES 2025, detailing its success strategies and key trends in the digital health sector. Chaneung Park, Mediaiplus's Business Development Manager, presented the company’s participation strategies, achievements, and major insights from the exhibition.

Founded in 2019 by CEO Jihee Jung, Mediaiplus was established to resolve bottlenecks in clinical trials that she encountered while working with global pharmaceutical companies Roche and Bayer. The company provides two core solutions, MediC and FiCRO, to enhance clinical trial efficiency.

MediC is an integrated platform that consolidates crucial clinical trial design information. It has the most extensive clinical trial database globally, surpassing even U.S. government-operated sites. MediC offers clinical trial reports, research papers, and patent guidelines.

‘FiCRO’ addresses challenges in selecting suitable contract research organizations (CROs) for clinical trials. It utilizes a database of over 29,500 CROs worldwide to analyze clinical trial RFPs (Request for Proposals) and match them with the most appropriate institutions.

body.cap: Chaneung Park, Business Development Manager at Mediaiplus | Image by AVING News

body.x: Regarding CES participation strategies, Park emphasized a ‘two-track strategy’ focusing on meticulous preparation and networking. Before the event, the company sent over 3,000 cold emails and scheduled 15 business meetings in advance. To enhance efficiency, they also hired local staff for on-site operations.

During CES, Mediaiplus systematically documented daily meeting results and promptly followed up on potential business leads. The company also engaged in technical discussions with developers to stay ahead of industry trends. Park highlighted that “80% of exhibition success is determined in the preparation stage,” underscoring the importance of structured pre-event planning.

Building on its CES experience, Mediaiplus plans to continue deal-closing efforts and strengthen inbound sales capabilities. In March, the company will apply insights gained at CES 2025 to maximize its success at upcoming global exhibitions, including MWC and BIO USA.

Park stated, “Through CES, we realized that our customer base is becoming more diverse and dynamic. Moving forward, we will refine our customer analysis and strategic responses to enhance engagement and business growth.”

Pangyo Techno Valley is a global R&D hub that integrates Research (R), People (P), Information (I), and Trade (T) across the IT, BT, CT, NT, and mobility sectors. It is a leading innovation cluster in Gyeonggi-do, established to drive technological innovation, talent development, job creation, and international business competitiveness.

The Gyeonggido Business and Science Accelerator’s Techno Valley Innovation Headquarters has continuously promoted Pangyo Techno Valley’s value by hosting events such as the Pangyo Evening Meet-Up, Pan-Pan Day, and Pangyo Startup Investment Exchange In-Best Pangyo. These initiatives have facilitated networking between Pangyo companies, domestic and international investors, and the media. Similar events are planned for this year to support the growth and global expansion of Pangyo startups through various assistance programs.
